main_body: stone tower building with conical green roof
top_band: green conical roof slope from row 4 to row 40
evidence: The building has a prominent sloped roof visible from above (rows 4-40, 37 rows tall) overhanging the vertical stone wall face (rows 41-94). Row 40-41 forms the roof edge/eave with shadow below it, and the window (rows 51-59) and door (rows 70-91) are recessed with inner shadows.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the candidate's stonework consists of large, uniform rectangular blocks filled with flat single colors (e.g. 6x3 flat grey rectangles) with no per-stone shading or speckle texture. The roof tiles are simple 2-color checker bands rather than richly shaded individual tiles, resulting in much lower information density.
